whyOrigyn.subtitle: ORIGYN, Where real-world assets meet blockchain.
whyOrigyn.body:
ORIGYN is the world's most advanced rwa protocol designed to bring real-world assets fully on-chain. from fine art and gold to luxury goods and intellectual property.

It provides a trustless certification infrastructure that ensures authenticity, provenance, and ownership of high-value assets.

items.title: 100% On-Chain Certification
items.description: No intermediaries, no tampering. Fully decentralized.

items.title: $OGY Token Utility
items.description: Powering the ORIGYN ecosystem through governance and protocol utility.

items.title: Multi-Asset Support
items.description: Certify art, luxury goods, gold, real estate, and more.

items.title: Industry-Leading Security

steps.description:
Bringing real-world assets on-chain should be simple. ORIGYN's certification process is designed to be secure, decentralized, and easy to use in just three steps:

Submit your asset's metadata and supporting documentation. ORIGYN generates a unique, tamper-proof digital certificate directly on the blockchain, assigning it to the asset and linking it to its rightful owner.
steps.panelDescription: Upload asset details, mint a blockchain certificate.

steps.description: Each certificate is cryptographically verifiable. Asset authenticity, provenance, and ownership are validated through ORIGYN's decentralized protocol.
steps.panelDescription: Ensure asset authenticity and ownership transparency.

steps.description: Once certified, your asset can be held, transferred, traded, or used within digital ecosystems, from DeFi applications and NFT marketplaces to private transactions and institutional records.
steps.panelDescription: Utilize and trace your certified asset for DeFi, resale, or investment.

gold.title: Gold
gold.description:
As the world's largest asset and most closely monitored commodity, gold requires the highest levels of security.

ORIGYN meets these requirements, as demonstrated by Metalor, the world leader in gold refining, which chose ORIGYN protocol to secure their data. For the first time, all technical information related to gold bars - including high-definition images and documents - is recorded in a single certificate on the blockchain.
Additionally, several projects like GoldDAO and Bity use these certificates to sell corresponding gold bars or create tokens backed by physical gold.

art.title: Art
art.description:
Art experts are deeply concerned about trust and the guarantee of certificates for artworks. This is why several cases have already adopted ORIGYN technology.

Established artists like Conor McCreedy and Leo Caillard have created their own ORIGYN certificates to protect the data related to their work. These certificates are fully on-chain, tamper-proof and impossible to copy, allowing artists to combat counterfeiting while improving the collector experience through high-definition images, videos, and documents.

Entities like foundations, organizations, families, galleries, and art advisors who need to create digital certificates for their clients started to use ORIGYN to maintain maximum security and confidentiality. Several galleries have already implemented ORIGYN technology, including the Retelet Gallery for certificates of René Magritte artworks.

ORIGYN technology also enables sales through certificates, particularly co-ownership sales. This allows artworks to be shared among multiple owners by dividing the certificate into several parts, each serving as proof of ownership.

madein.title: Made in
madein.description:
National origin is more than a label. It is a declaration of identity, quality, and cultural value. As counterfeiting rises, proving where and how a product is made has become a key differentiator for brands across industries.

In response, Federitaly created the 100% Made in Italy certification. This legally recognized standard protects Italian excellence through strict documentation, independent audits, and government-level advocacy. ORIGYN provides the digital foundation of this system by recording every certified product on the blockchain as a verifiable proof of origin.

Each certificate becomes a secure, tamper-proof digital passport. It reinforces consumer trust, ensures transparency across the supply chain, and supports businesses that choose to lead with authenticity.

luxury.title: Luxury
luxury.description:
ORIGYN technology addresses the luxury sector's need to reinvent itself and offer more personalized, transparent product experiences.

Jeweler Suzanne Syz uses ORIGYN blockchain technology to create certificates for their entire collection. This secures all data fully on-chain while offering their prestigious customers next-generation certificates that guarantee confidentiality, authenticity, and ownership.

Other luxury companies like Gil Sertissage also use ORIGYN to record the complete traceability chain of their diamonds destined for renowned watchmakers.Many other applications are possible, including adding personalized marketing content to certificates or combining the technology with AI to determine authenticity in real time for secondary markets.

hero.subtitle: JOIN THE INTEGRATOR PROGRAM TO BUILD THE FUTURE OF TRUST WITH ORIGYN'S BLOCKCHAIN CERTIFICATION TECHNOLOGY

steps.description: The Integrator Program is a strategic initiative aimed at promoting the ORIGYN protocol, encouraging its adoption and broadening its ecosystem.

• Integrators are independent firms that build products based on the ORIGYN protocol with a common goal of minting ORIGYN certificates and promoting the ORIGYN protocol in a specific industry, in an asset class or across multiple sectors.
  • Acting as enablers, they help businesses to adopt ORIGYN's blockchain certification technology without requiring deep blockchain and Web3 expertise.
  • Following a vetting process conducted by the ORIGYN Foundation, integrators are elected and voted by the ORIGYN DAO token holders.
To become an integrator a company must show that it can deliver services at scale, while meeting all the requirements and expertise to serve a specific or multiple sectors.

steps.title: Application form
steps.content:
As part of the application, Integrators must fill the Project Application form online and prepare the Due Diligence Documentation to be sent at admin@origyn.ch

Due diligence documentation includes:

  • Copy of Certificate of incorporation
  • Description of UBO - Unique Beneficial Owners
  • Copy of Memorandum & Articles of Association
  • Resolution of the Board of Directors that formalize the willingness to apply as Integrator and comply with Staking rules together with list of officials authorized to operate the Integrator
  • Identification of authorized signatories should be based on photographs and signature cards duly attested by the company
  • Copies of proof of identity and proof of address of managers, officers of employees holding Power of Attorney to transact business on its behalf
  • List of directors
  • Integrator Project Application Form

steps.title: Review from ORIGYN Foundation
steps.content: The first step to become an Integrator is to be validated by the ORIGYN Foundation after a due diligence process. The Integrator accepts to share all the documents requested with the purpose of fulfilling all KYC/KYB/AML required procedures.

steps.title: Governance vote via ORIGYN DAO
steps.content:
PUBLIC VOTE BY ORIGYN DAO:

Once the Foundation concludes the vetting process, the Integrator will be subject to a DAO vote via a public proposal on the SNS Platform. All ORIGYN proposals can be viewed at https://nns.ic0.app/proposals/?u=leu43-oiaaa-aaaaq-aadgq-cai.

Every change of either legal entity address, business name, or termination of cooperation is voted publicly on the SNS Platform.

steps.title: Staking of 50,000,000 OGY
steps.content:
If the proposal successfully passes, the Integrator will have to proceed to stake 50,000,000 OGY in the ORIGYN Governance for 1 year non dissolving.

This step ensures the long term commitment of the Integrator and voting power to participate actively in the governance of ORIGYN. All the Staked Neurons will be shown in the Dashboard publicly at https://dashboard.origyn.com

All statistics such as Of certificates minted, TVL of certified assets, ect will be publicly shown under the integrator part on the https://dashboard.origyn.com.

steps.title: Performance review
steps.content:
Depending on each sector and commitment, minimum requirements for number of certificates minted can be part of the Integrator agreement. Hence ORIGYN Foundation will periodically conduct milestones and performance review of the Integrators.

All statistics such as n. of certificates minted, TVL of certified assets, etc. will be publicly shown under the integrator part on the https://dashboard.origyn.com.

subtitle: Open R&D on running fully autonomous AI agents on a public blockchain.
No off-chain shortcuts. Verifiable by design.

phrases: You are what you know and remember.
Lose that, and you lose yourself.
AI works exactly the same way.
Without persistent memory, even the smartest agent is just noise.
True intelligence isn’t how powerful the model is — it’s how well it knows you.
You are your memory. So is your Agent.
No memory. No identity. No trust.

On-chain memory. On-chain identity. On-chain loyalty.
The most powerful agent is the one that never forgets you.

problem.title: No one actually runs AI on-chain.
problem.lead: Every project that claims to have an <s>“on-chain AI agent”</s> follows the same pattern : inference runs off-chain, on centralized servers, and only the result is posted to the blockchain. The model never executes inside the network. The chain is used as a bulletin board, not as a compute layer.
problem.leadStrong: That is not an on-chain agent. That is an API call with a receipt.

steps.title: The claim
steps.body: “AI-powered on-chain agent.” Inference happens on AWS. The chain only stores the output.

steps.title: The gap
steps.body: No verifiable execution. No deterministic replay. No way to audit what the model actually computed.

steps.title: Our approach
steps.body: Full inference inside the canister. WASM SIMD, on the Swiss Subnet. Verifiable, reproducible, truly on-chain.

problem.closing: We have already demonstrated this. <s>Origyn</s> runs real inference on-chain today. We are now in an active testing phase, stress-testing robustness across models and workloads to confirm what our benchmarks already show : this is the most reliable <s>on-chain AI</s> inference stack that exists.

agent.title: Origyn. Minimal agent, maximal memory.
agent.lead: A sovereign AI agent running on-chain. Its first mission: the Sovereign Second Brain. A small model fed by decades of your structured context, certified on the Swiss blockchain. Not a giant model on-chain. A focused agent with a certified vault.

cards.title: User side
cards.subtitle: Local Bureau
cards.body: The user’s machine. Large language models, private files, offline work. Your intelligence stays with you.

cards.title: Blockchain side
cards.subtitle: On-Chain Vault
cards.body: The canister. Certified vault, verifiable inference, deterministic replay. Your context becomes provable infrastructure.

vault.title: Certified by construction.

cards.title: Legal proof of existence

cards.title: Full provenance
cards.body: Who created, modified, certified each document. Immutable traceability chain.

cards.title: Versioning
cards.body: Every version preserved. Roll back at any time.

cards.title: Controlled sharing
cards.body: Read-only, time-limited, revocable in one click. Works even when offline.

cards.title: Dead man’s switch
cards.body: Designated heirs automatically recover access after a defined period of inactivity.

cards.title: Immutable audit trail
cards.body: Who saw what, when, why. Full regulatory compliance built in.

cards.title: 24/7 monitoring
cards.body: The canister runs even when your PC is off. Automatic alerts for anomalies.

cards.title: Certified assets
cards.body: Tokenized gold, real estate, collectibles. Provenance certificates alongside cognitive patrimony.

results.title: Faster than the existing.
results.lead: Same models, same conditions, production network. Our custom WASM SIMD kernels make the difference.
results.body1: For the same compute budget, a Second Brain powered by our fork does three times more work, or consumes three times fewer resources.
body2: We are not tied to any single model or architecture. Every new release is an opportunity.
We continuously benchmark and integrate the latest models to push speed, accuracy, and efficiency further.

cards.title: Fleet of micro-experts
cards.body: Instead of one slow large model, we deploy task-specific finetuned sub-1B parameter models: sorting emails, classifying documents, evaluating risk. Faster and more precise than a generalist.

cards.title: On-chain distillation
cards.body: A large model teaches off-chain, a small model deploys on-chain. Combined with 4-bit quantization and our custom WASM SIMD kernels, this enables real AI within a canister’s instruction budget.
